scripts.audit: npm run audit:gems && npm run audit:npm
scripts.audit:fix: npm run audit:fix:gems && npm run audit:fix:npm
scripts.audit:fix:gems: docker compose run --rm web sh -lc 'bundle update && bundle exec bundle-audit check --update'
scripts.audit:fix:npm: docker compose run --rm web sh -lc 'npm audit fix && npm audit --package-lock-only'
scripts.audit:gems: docker compose run --rm web sh -lc 'bundle install && bundle exec bundle-audit check --update'
scripts.audit:npm: docker compose run --rm web sh -lc 'npm audit --package-lock-only'
scripts.dev:restart: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
scripts.dev:stop: npm run --silent dev:down && rm -f tmp/pids/server.pid && npm run --silent print:green -- 'Dev services stopped; Rails PID cleared.' && npm run --silent postgres:check-port
scripts.postgres:check-port: sh -lc 'if lsof -i:5432 >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm run --silent print:red -- "Local PostgreSQL port 5432 is still in use:"; lsof -i:5432; else npm run --silent print:green -- "Local PostgreSQL port 5432 is free."; fi'
